name: Stix
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Ferienwohnung Stix is located on the tranquil outskirts of Thiersee, offering picturesque views of the surrounding peaks. The property features a welcoming apartment with a private entrance, a fully equipped kitchen, and a balcony. Guests can reach the ski slopes and Lake Thiersee in just a few minutes for summertime water fun and outdoor pursuits. It is an ideal self-catering retreat for discovering the beauty of the Tyrolean mountains.
